summary: Comprehensive testing of Fluence House platform completed. Backend APIs working perfectly (100% success). Frontend core functionality working well with successful login, registration, dashboard loading, and campaign creation. Critical DashboardRouter fix validated successfully. Session persistence issue identified affecting navigation between protected routes.

integration_issues.issue: Users get redirected to login when navigating directly to protected routes (/dashboard, /profile, /campaigns) even after successful login
integration_issues.impact: Affects user experience - users need to login again when navigating between pages

passed_tests: Backend API Authentication (JWT login, registration, token refresh, logout)
Backend Campaign Management (create, list, get details)
Backend Payout System (create, list by role)
Backend Dashboard Statistics (influencer and brand views)
Frontend Brand Dashboard Loading with Stats and Campaigns
Frontend Create Campaign Dialog and Form Submission
Frontend Influencer Dashboard Loading with Stats and Quick Actions
Frontend Role-based Dashboard Routing (DashboardRouter fix validated)
Frontend Success Notifications (campaign creation, account creation)
Frontend Responsive Design and UI Components
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix session persistence issue: Users are redirected to login when navigating directly to protected routes. The token refresh mechanism works in API testing but may not be properly integrated with frontend routing. Check AuthContext token persistence and ProtectedRoute component.
